name: Awei T92 Anc Pro 6-mic Deep Noise Reduction Wireless Earbuds ( 6-Month Official Warranty )
description:
Awei T92 ANC Pro TWS Earbuds | 6-Mic Deep Noise Reduction | Dolby Cinema Audio

Immerse yourself in cinematic-quality sound with the Awei T92 ANC Pro Earbuds. Featuring 6-mic ANC + ENC, Bluetooth 5.4, and long-lasting battery life, these earbuds are designed for clear calls, powerful music, and a premium listening experience anytime, anywhere.

Key Features

6-Mic Noise Reduction: Advanced ANC + ENC technology reduces ambient noise for crystal-clear calls and immersive music.

Dolby Cinema Audio Quality: Enjoy rich bass, clear mids, and high-definition sound for a theater-like audio experience.

Bluetooth 5.4: Stable, low-latency wireless connection up to 10 meters.

Battery & Playtime:

Earbuds: 35mAh each

Charging Case: 300mAh

Music Playback: ~6 hours

Talk Time: ~4 hours

Charging Time: 1.5 hours

Compact & Portable: Lightweight and easy to carry with a sleek, modern design.

Convenient Controls: Manage calls, music, and voice assistant functions with intuitive touch controls.

📦 Package Includes

1 × Pair of Awei T92 ANC Pro Earbuds

1 × Charging Case (300mAh)

1 × USB Charging Cable

1 × User Manual
